edits.insert:
OfficialWeatherCard(
                  warningStatus: officialAlertStatus,
                  hasActiveWarnings: activeOfficialAlerts.isNotEmpty,
                  outlookText: _officialOutlook.isEmpty
                      ? (_officialBulletinUnavailable
                          ? 'Official bulletin unavailable; pull down to retry.'
                          : 'Checking the official island forecast…')
                      : _officialOutlookVerifiedToday
                          ? weatherOutlookSynopsis(_officialOutlook)
                          : 'Validity unverified · ${weatherOutlookSynopsis(_officialOutlook)}',
                  sourceDetails: 'Antigua & Barbuda Meteorological Service\n'
                      'Warnings checked: ${_clock(_alertsChecked)}\n'
                      'Outlook issued: ${_officialOutlookIssued ?? 'unverified'}\n'
                      'Outlook checked: ${_clock(_officialBulletinChecked)}\n'
                      '${_officialOutlookVerifiedToday ? 'Current forecast outlook' : 'Validity unverified'}\n'
                      'Forecast outlooks are separate from active warnings.\n'
                      'Full outlook: $_officialOutlook',
                  onOpenBulletin: _openOfficialAlert,
